milestone.goal: Increment 1 — A working split view. Deliver: Tauri 2.x shell launching on Windows, file menu (Open/Save/Save As/Recent/Close via native dialogs), Monaco editor loading OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 YAML+JSON (language auto-detected from extension with UI override), debounced parse (200ms) updating a swagger-ui-react view with 'Try it out' disabled, last-good view retained on parse errors, schema validation on by default via monaco-yaml against the OpenAPI 3.1 schema cached in app_data_dir, red squiggles for violations, Save preserving line endings and encoding. No reader file, no copy-context command, no terminal — those are Increment 2 and 3. Perf: open Petstore 3.1 in <200ms; 10k-line spec responsive during Monaco highlight; keystroke-to-preview p95 <250ms. See product-brief.md for the full brief, architecture.md for lanes, ipc-contract.md for the IPC starting point. The GitHub repo is at https://github.com/BIoodHound/apicoord and already has an initial scaffold commit — do NOT force-push or re-init; commits land as fast-forwards on main.
milestone.spec_summary: Six m1 specs (foundation, file-io, menu-lifecycle, editor, preview, validation) already existed and match the council decision, so I left them unchanged. The architecture.md update was blocked because product-manager does not own that file. The proposed content is in my reply for the architect to apply: Rust-owned file I/O, menu and MRU; frontend-owned buffer, parse worker, preview and validation; no network; strict CSP; the new module map; the fixed test gate; the keystroke-to-preview data flow; and M1 IPC commands and events. ipc-contract.md was not re-checked against the new commands.
open_questions: Drop the remote schema fetch and copy the bundled 3.0 and 3.1 schemas into app_data_dir on first run (leaning, no network code), or keep a reqwest fetch with a bundled fallback? The brief and your goal asked for fetch-and-cache.
Windows performance verification: a manual QA run on a Windows laptop recorded in the increment report (leaning), or add a Windows CI runner?
If big-10k.yaml misses 250ms p95: report the miss and ship with a longer debounce above 5,000 lines (leaning), or hold the increment?
Save As on an unedited buffer: write the original bytes (assumed) or re-encode?
Does the session-only language override survive Save As? Assumed yes, and it resets when another file opens.
Mixed-EOL file after an edit: save with the majority EOL and show a status-bar note only (assumed), or prompt first?
Show encoding and EOL in the status bar? Assumed yes.
architecture.md still needs the architect to apply the m1 changes listed in my reply, and ipc-contract.md needs the M1 command detail.
